CERTIFIED MUNICIPAL CANDIDATES

To appear on the October 6, 2026 Municipal Election ballot, candidates must have completed and submitted the required filing forms during the candidate filing period.

Important: Assembly districts apply only to candidate residency requirements and are different from State elections. All Assembly and Board of Education seats are elected at-large, and all qualified voters may vote in every Assembly and Board of Education race on the ballot.
